questions.questionEn: What could a family do with its theatre box in early La Scala?

options.textEn: Decorate it to suit their taste.
Choose the conductor for each show.
Decide who could use the stage door.

questions.hintJa: 客席の一角が家の部屋に近かった時代の話。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 桟敷を所有する家族は内装を自分好みにでき、貸したり譲ったりもできた。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 内装の自由から公演の指揮者や楽屋の管理権は導けない。 桟敷を所有する家族は内装を自分好みにでき、貸したり譲ったりもできた。

sources.title: Curios at La Scala
sources.claimJa: 桟敷を所有する家族は内装を自分好みにでき、貸したり譲ったりもできた。

A2.questionEn: In the early years of La Scala, what could a family do with its box in the theatre?

options.textEn: Make it beautiful in the way they liked.
Choose the conductor for each show.
Decide who could use the door to the stage.

B2.questionEn: In La Scala's early days, what were families entitled to do with the boxes they held?

options.textEn: Decorate them in accordance with their own taste.
Select the conductor for every performance.
Determine who might use the stage door.

questions.questionEn: Which record challenges the claim that the stalls always had fixed seats?

options.textEn: Families decorated their own boxes.
Visitors hired movable seats in the stalls.
Electric light filled the auditorium.

questions.hintJa: 主張と同じ場所・同じ物について述べる証拠を探そう。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 初期の平土間の椅子は可動式で、座る客が借りた。これだけで「いつも固定」は崩れる。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 桟敷の所有と客席の照明はどちらも史実だが、平土間の椅子を動かせたかは示さない。 初期の平土間の椅子は可動式で、座る客が借りた。これだけで「いつも固定」は崩れる。

sources.title: Curios at La Scala
sources.claimJa: 初期の平土間の椅子は可動式で、座る客が借りた。これだけで「いつも固定」は崩れる。

A2.questionEn: Someone says the seats on the main floor were always fixed in place. Which record shows this is not right?

options.textEn: Families made their own boxes beautiful.
Visitors paid to use seats on the main floor that could be moved.
Electric light filled the theatre.

B2.questionEn: Which piece of documentary evidence undermines the assertion that the stalls were always equipped with fixed seating?

options.textEn: Families decorated boxes of their own.
Patrons rented movable chairs in the stalls.
Electric lighting flooded the auditorium.

questions.questionEn: What did people do among the ruins before the theatre fully reopened?

options.textEn: They sold the boxes at an auction.
They built a second stage for rehearsals.
They held a concert with ordinary chairs for the audience.

questions.hintJa: 音楽を再開するのに何が必要だったのか。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 戦災後、正式再開に先立つ演奏では、観客が普通の椅子に座った。再開記念公演と区別しよう。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 桟敷の競売や別の稽古場の建設は、この演奏に関する記述ではない。 戦災後、正式再開に先立つ演奏では、観客が普通の椅子に座った。再開記念公演と区別しよう。

sources.title: History of the Theatre
sources.claimJa: 戦災後、正式再開に先立つ演奏では、観客が普通の椅子に座った。再開記念公演と区別しよう。

A2.questionEn: Before the theatre was fully open again, what did people do in its ruins?

options.textEn: They sold the boxes to the people who paid the most.
They built a second stage for practice.
They had a concert. The audience sat on ordinary chairs.

B2.questionEn: Prior to the theatre's full reopening, what took place amid the ruins?

options.textEn: The boxes were auctioned off.
A second stage was constructed for rehearsals.
A concert was staged, with the audience seated on ordinary chairs.
